description: As the AFSCME Union President, I have been successful in contract negotiation and process improvement. I remain calm and poised even in high-pressure situations.
I leverage my deep understanding of industry trends and shifts to offer valuable insights on opportunities for new growth and expansion.
I provided operational support to the Section Aviation Manager and technical assistance to field aviators.
I planned, directed, coordinated, and controlled all aspects of public or private airports/heliports to ensure compliance with state regulations for safety procedures.
I supported the Policy and Planning Division with accounting and administrative duties within grants and revolving loan programs.
I processed time-sensitive grant amendments received from airport sponsors/owners and prepared letters to congressmen, state senators, and representatives for State Block Grant Program.
I assisted with the day-to-day operations of the Department of Transportation's Riverside Office Center mailroom, coordinating different types of mailing machines for proper distribution.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has extensive experience leading a union office with responsibilities including contract negotiation, process improvement, staff development, cross-functional team management, and policy/program development. They have demonstrated strong leadership skills by taking on positions such as Vice President of AFSCME District Council 90's board and implementing improvements in the organization structure through more efficient filing systems and database protocols. Their ability to remain calm under pressure is evident from their successful handling of high-pressure situations, including negotiations.
